blocks.x: Corporate learning and vocational systems are judged on capability transfer: skills taxonomy, personalized pathways, credential portability and employer verification. The systems that prove skill deltas win the budget conversation.

The workflows we industrialize here: Skills taxonomy management, Pathway personalization, Assessment/verification, Credential issuance, Employer reporting. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.
